---
title: "Phase 2: Extended NEPA Analysis"
---

Phase 2 extends the [Phase 1 analysis](../reports/project_overview.html) with an improved DuckDB-based pipeline and deeper extraction capabilities.

## Status

Phase 2 is in active development. Reports will appear here as deliverables are completed.

## Key improvements

- **DuckDB-based pipeline** — faster data loading and joins across large document sets
- **Improved timeline extraction** — refined BERT classifiers with LLM adjudication for ambiguous cases
- **Extended coverage** — additional extraction dimensions beyond Phase 1 deliverables

Phase 1 deliverables (frozen at `freeze/v1.0`) are available under the **Phase 1** menu above.
